title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
why_read: A solid robotics RL paper introducing a faster off-policy method for training flow-based policies, with real hardware transfer results.
analysis: QF3 is a reinforcement learning algorithm for training 'flow policies,' a increasingly popular way to represent robot behavior that borrows ideas from diffusion-style generative models. The key technical contribution is backpropagating a critic's gradient through a one-step approximation of the flow policy, while restricting that gradient to action dimensions it trusts, which stabilizes training. The paper demonstrates a 10x speedup over a recent on-policy baseline and claims the first zero-shot sim-to-hardware transfer of a humanoid locomotion policy trained this way. This is a meaningful, measurable advance for people working on sample-efficient robot learning rather than just an incremental tweak.
